_comment: Everything the orchestrator needs to know about this instrument beyond its commands. Delete the sections you do not need. library_types: files it reads (a parameter becomes a picker). result_types: folders under Results/ it writes (created when the server starts, listed on the Results page). parameter_defaults: parameters a workflow may omit. traceability: commands that prepare (prepares_plate) or measure (measures_plate) a plate. See v1/src/catalog.py.
